summary: Checked all six estimates against the supplied publisher PDF and the extraction specification and codebook. Read the complete 66,786-character markdown conversion in six contiguous chunks through the final reference; the document contains no appendix or supplement. Extracted PDF pp. 7-10 (printed pp. 1437-1440) to verify assignment, measurement, exclusions, analysis scope, and every estimate source; recovered the result tables with find_tables. All nine estimate source quotes match their cited PDF pages. The recorded F statistics, degrees of freedom, p-values, Management arm means, and partial eta-squared values are printed for their named outcomes and arms. All eight supplied checker alerts are false positives: PDF p. 9 prints F(1,198) for S1 fluency and originality; PDF p. 10 prints F(1,120) for S2 fluency and F(1,198) for S2 originality. Management originality denominator df 198 is retained as printed, despite the other Management tests using 120; Table 2 supplies p = .064, while the text rounds it to .06. Analysis person counts are not printed, and recruitment figures precede duplicate removal and other exclusions, so the null counts are appropriate. Table parenthetical values are not identified as SDs or SEs and correctly remain unclassified. The question, construct, measure, direction, AI availability, timing, between-person design, and comparison codes agree with the described tasks. Participant unit and se_basis follow the per-respondent submission analysis; the paper does not explain rater aggregation, as already documented in the extraction. No additional eligible full-sample contrast was found: Table 1 contains discipline subgroup comparisons, flexibility was dropped without a reported contrast, and omnibus MANOVA and interaction tests are not separate scored outcomes. The S1 univariate values are transcribed under the intervention-versus-control labels actually printed in the paper. Their possible inconsistency with Table 1 remains a source-reporting uncertainty, already flagged in the extraction; the PDF supplies no corrected labels or replacement values. No extraction error was established.
